records.summary: Manuela's second B/1 interview at Safed: documents sent 3 months ahead and the office replied with what was missing, the appointment was moved earlier twice, the clerk was friendly, and a 2-year B/1 was granted.
practices: Available by email and replies with the missing documents when they are sent 3 months in advance
Asks to be emailed 4 months before the visa expires and then sends the list of required documents
Can move the interview earlier when asked by email
Interviews the partner with questions on family, daily life and that day, while the other fills in AS3
